== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Lando_Calrissian_Unlikely_Hero.png]]) shows the original text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-landocalrissianunlikelyhero-pre.gif]]) shows the current PC-E2 text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-12-12 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in the capture of 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 3 to anything he pilots. May reveal from hand to take Luxury Yacht into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; and deploy both simultaneously. While piloting (or with a female), adds one battle destiny. During battle, may target a card here. Draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, target is forfeit = 0.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1282_14 (Luxury Yacht kept as in this version)</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. The pilot icon and the ▲ are drawn where the card list writes them out (“Adds 3 to anything he pilots”, “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”). The frame is CardMaker's plain Light Side character frame; the printed card's red-tinted frame is not in CardMaker.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
